reader.requirement: At --std 85 the connected conditions of each hierarchical level (an AND level, an OR level, a parenthesized level, an abbreviated combined relation's expansion), in every statement that takes a condition (IF, PERFORM UNTIL, EVALUATE WHEN, SEARCH WHEN), are evaluated left to right and the level stops as soon as its truth value is known.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.UnphrasedSizeErrorIsFatal: below 2002 a relation or sign condition whose operand performs arithmetic is wrapped in CobolSizeError.FalseWhenRaised(() => ...), a deferred lambda, so a size error makes the leaf false; at 2002+ it renders bare and a size error is fatal

reader.edition-search: grep -i 'edition|DialectLevel|Version' over ConditionRenderer.cs and ConditionBinder.cs. The binder's ctx.Edition uses are boolean-expression diagnostics (a 2002 construct). The renderer's other DialectLevel reads (lines 463, 475, 1167) choose an operand's comparison image, not the evaluation order. BoundLogical renders as C# && / || in operand order and BoundNot as !(...), at every edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the && / || order has one rendering; the 85 size-error arm wraps a leaf in a lambda, which keeps the leaf lazy
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf15_02 covers IF only; PERFORM UNTIL, EVALUATE WHEN, SEARCH WHEN, an abbreviated combined relation, AND-over-OR precedence without parentheses, and a guarded division or subscript are not exercised

probes.printed: C1 F / C2 T / C3 F / C4 K=0 SEQ=5 / C5 OTHER SEQ=5 / C6 T SEQ=5 / C7 F SEQ=5 / C8 T SEQ=5 / C9 F SEQ=5 / C10 END / C11 SEQ=X (MATCH at --std 85 and at --std 2023)
probes.expected: GR1: once a level is decided, the RANDOM(7)/RANDOM(9) re-seed is never evaluated (SEQ=5) in PERFORM UNTIL, EVALUATE WHEN, the abbreviated F = 1 OR 2 AND ..., NOT (...), and figure 4's shape; it IS evaluated when needed (C11 SEQ=X)
an evaluated N / 0 makes the leaf false at 85 and is fatal at 2023, so cnd1's C1/C2 MATCH at 2023 shows the guarded division was never evaluated

citations.check: OK  §1985:VI.6.3.4 GR1  the text is in GR1 (quoted: "evaluated in order from left to right")

reader.notes: BindFlatSequence keeps the operands in written order, and ConditionRenderer.Visit(BoundLogical) joins them with C# && / ||, which short-circuit. At 85 a leaf with arithmetic goes through SizeErrorGuarded's deferred lambda, still inside the && chain, so the 85 arm stays lazy. At 85 the guarded-division lines (C1-C3) cannot tell the two orders apart, because an evaluated zero divide is false there; the RANDOM lines can.

refuter.evidence: cr1.cob: an abbreviated OR level 'I > 10 OR TE (I) = "A" OR "B"' with I=11 on a 10-entry table gives B1 T with no fault; 'J = 0 OR TE (J)' gives B2 T; inline PERFORM VARYING ... UNTIL J > 10 OR TE (J) NOT = "A" ends at J=11 with no fault (B3); EVALUATE TRUE ALSO TRUE WHEN I > 10 OR TE (I) = "A" ALSO I NOT > 10 gives OTHER (B4); NOT (I NOT > 10 AND TE (I) = "A") gives T (B5). cr2.cob: a guarded sign condition over N / D (D=0) gives S1 F / S2 T, a guarded subscripted condition-name IS-A (I) S3 F, a guarded class condition S4 T, PERFORM WITH TEST AFTER UNTIL W = 1 OR FUNCTION RANDOM > 2 never calls RANDOM (S5 SKIPPED), and a needed nested level is evaluated (S6 T). cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.3.4 GR1 ("evaluation of that hierarchical level terminates as soon as a truth value for it is determined").
